text:
Maria Chen: Hey team — opening a small PR to refresh the starter webapp quick tutorial to SDK v4. Main goals: update auth example (Bearer -> x-api-key header), fix the Dockerfile caching layers, and add a short migration note for folks on SDK3. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2487 :wave:
Samir Patel: Thanks Maria. Can you drop the minimal code diff you'll include for the migration note? I'll volunteer to review the docs wording and run the Docker build on my macbook (M1). :thumbsup:
Maria Chen: Sure — adding snippet now. Migration note will show old vs new usage:

```diff
- from redwood import Client
- client = Client(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
+ from @redwood/inference import Redwood
+ client = Redwood({ "apiKey": process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
```

Also swapping the example request header to `x-api-key` and showing curl:

```bash
curl -H "x-api-key: $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

Samir Patel: Nice and concise. One nit: can we keep the python example too? Many starter users still use py. Maybe show both short snippets.

Maria Chen: Good call — will add a tiny python example too.

Ryan O'Neill: Quick note on the Docker change — prefer this pattern for layer caching:

```dockerfile
FROM node:20-alpine AS deps
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json package-lock.json ./
RUN npm ci --only=production

FROM node:20-alpine
COPY --from=deps /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY . .
CMD ["node","server.js"]
```

This keeps installs separate from app changes. I ran it locally, image size trimmed ~60MB.

Leah Park: I can do a docs lint pass after the PR lands. Also would be great to add a short troubleshooting table about common auth errors (401/403) and where to check logs in the Console.

Maria Chen: I'll add a Troubleshooting subsection with 401 -> missing x-api-key and 403 -> key not allowed for model. For logs, link to Console > Projects > Logs.

Alex G: FYI the sample env var name in the dashboard is REDWOOD_KEY not REDWOOD_API_KEY. We should be consistent. :eyes:

Maria Chen: Good catch — updating examples to use REDWOOD_KEY across all snippets.

Samir Patel: I'll test the live quickstart steps after you push the updated README. If you want, I can also check the Windows PowerShell curl example (different quoting rules).

Maria Chen: Appreciate it. Plan: push updates to the PR today, address review comments, then ping @leah for final lint and @samir for verification. Aim to merge by EOD tomorrow. :calendar:

docs-bot: PR 2487 — docs linter passed. 3 changed files. (auto-check)

Leah Park: Taking a look now. Small suggestion — make the migration note a collapsible section (summary) so the quickstart stays short.

Maria Chen: Done. Collapsible summary added. Pushed. Thanks all! :rocket:

Samir Patel: Verified the example deploy works on my M1, Windows PS curl tweak added, and the python snippet renders fine in the site. No blockers from me.

Leah Park: Lint clean, editorial nits fixed, links verified. Happy to merge once PR description adds a one-line summary for release notes.

Maria Chen: Updated PR description with release-note-friendly line. Merging after CI completes.

docs-bot: CI passed. Merged PR 2487 into main. :white_check_mark:

Maria Chen: Thanks everyone — I'll follow up with a short announcement in #general once the site build finishes.
